lines.say: Your app's data outgrows one database server. It can't hold it all, or keep up with every write. Copies won't help, because every write still lands on one machine.
lines.show: Your app's data *outgrows* one database server. It can't *hold it all,* or keep up with every *write.* Copies won't help, because every write still lands on [one machine.]

lines.say: So you split the data across several database servers. Each one is called a shard, and holds only some of the users.
lines.show: So you *split* the data across several database servers. Each one is called a [shard,] and holds only *some* of the users.

lines.say: To decide where a user lives, you pick a shard key, like the user ID. A simple rule turns that ID into a shard number.
lines.show: To decide where a user lives, you pick a [shard key,] like the *user ID.* A simple rule turns that ID into a *shard number.*

lines.say: User 42 lives on shard 2. So the app goes straight to that one shard, not all of them.
lines.show: User *42* lives on [shard 2.] So the app goes straight to that *one shard,* not all of them.

lines.say: Like a library split into two buildings. Authors A to M in one, N to Z in the other. You know where to walk.
lines.show: Like a library split into [two buildings.] Authors *A to M* in one, *N to Z* in the other. You know where to [walk.]

lines.say: Now each shard handles a slice of the reads and writes. Need more room? Add more shards.
lines.show: Now each shard handles a *slice* of the reads and writes. Need more room? [Add more shards.]

lines.say: But there's a cost. A question about all users, like who signed up today, has to ask every shard and combine the answers.
lines.show: But there's a *cost.* A question about all users, like who signed up today, has to ask [every shard] and *combine* the answers.

lines.say: Pick a bad key, and one shard gets most of the traffic while the others sit idle. That's a hot shard.
lines.show: Pick a *bad key,* and one shard gets most of the traffic while the others sit *idle.* That's a [hot shard.]

lines.say: And moving data when you add shards is hard. So most apps shard last, after simpler fixes like caching and replicas.
lines.show: And moving data when you add shards is *hard.* So most apps shard [last,] after simpler fixes like *caching* and *replicas.*

lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
